name: South Carolina

sources.label: S.C. Code of Regulations, Chapter 43, R. 43-234 (Graduation Requirements)
S.C. State Register Doc. No. 5130 — financial literacy amendment to R. 43-234 (effective May 2023)

plans.name: South Carolina High School Diploma

subjects.label: Social Studies
subjects.notes: U.S. History and Constitution 1, Economics 0.5, U.S. Government 0.5, and 1 more social studies credit

subjects.label: World Language or Career and Technology Education
subjects.notes: Either a world language or a CTE course counts.

subjects.label: Financial Literacy
subjects.notes: A full credit in the CTE Personal Finance course also meets this.

plans.notes: Includes 6.5 elective credits. Students may also earn optional endorsements in a career pathway, but these are not needed to graduate.

otherRequirements: Pass a classroom exam on the U.S. Constitution, the Declaration of Independence, the Federalist Papers, and American institutions
Take the civics test made from the 100 U.S. citizenship test questions, as part of the U.S. Government course
Pass a high school science course that has a state end-of-course exam
Be enrolled for at least one semester right before you graduate (summer school does not count)
districtNote: These are South Carolina's statewide minimums; your school district may require more credits or courses.
